title: Taming the Tails of Stochastic Gradient Descent in the Interpolation Regime
abstract: arXiv:2611.24562v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we study stochastic gradient descent in the smooth interpolation regime, where the population objective shares a common minimizer with the sample losses. In contrast to prior work, which has largely focused on in-expectation analysis, we obtain high-probability convergence guarantees under the same assumptions. In the convex case, we prove a fast rate of order $\log(\beta^{-1}) \cdot n^{-1}$ after $n$ iterations, with failure probability at most $\beta$. In the strongly convex case, we derive a family of moment-based bounds of order $\beta^{-p} \cdot \exp(-\mathcal{O}(p \cdot n))$ for $p \in (0,1]$, and complement them with a matching lower bound showing that the corresponding deterioration in the exponential rate is essentially unavoidable. translated_title: 驯服插值机制下随机梯度下降的尾部
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们研究了光滑插值机制下的随机梯度下降，即总体目标函数与样本损失共享同一个最小值点。与以往主要集中于期望意义下分析的工作不同，我们在相同的假设条件下获得了高概率收敛保证。在凸函数情形下，我们证明了经过 n 次迭代后可达到 log(β⁻¹)·n⁻¹ 阶的快速收敛速率，且失败概率至多为 β。在强凸情形下，我们推导出一族基于矩的界，其阶为 β⁻ᵖ·exp(-O(p·n))，其中 p ∈ (0,1]，并给出了与之匹配的下界，表明指数收敛速率的相应劣化在本质上是不可避免的。在这两种情形下，我们的理论结果统一适用于一大类步长调度策略。基于这一分析，我们将结果进一步扩展到低噪声机制以及非凸（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次在插值机制下为随机梯度下降建立了高概率收敛保证，在凸情形证明了 log(β⁻¹)·n⁻¹ 的快速率，在强凸情形给出了一族基于矩的界及其匹配下界，证明指数速率的劣化本质上是不可避免的。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes high-probability convergence guarantees for SGD in the interpolation regime, proving a fast log(β⁻¹)·n⁻¹ rate in the convex case and a family of moment-based bounds with matching lower bounds in the strongly convex case, showing that the deterioration of the exponential rate is essentially unavoidable.
